title: Johnson & Johnson’s ICOTYDE Meets Primary Endpoint in Phase 3 Psoriatic Arthritis Trial
summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) announced that its investigational treatment ICOTYDE (icotrokinra) achieved the primary endpoint in a Phase 3 clinical trial involving adults with active psoriatic arthritis who had not previously received biologic therapies. The ICONIC-PsA 1 study evaluated the efficacy and safety of ICOTYDE at a dose of 200 mg administered once daily.
